summary: Plan host hardware inventory and temperature sensors: Core discovers its own hardware and records hwmon temperatures in host usage history; the host Stats tab gains a hardware panel, gauges and a temperature chart. Planning only. API impact: none — the plan declares a changed stats contract and a new hardware contract for the implementing slices, which carry those decisions.

guide.reason: No behaviour changes; the usage history guide is updated in the implementing slices.

api.reason: Planning only. The plan declares an additive temperature group on the host stats contract and a new GET /api/v1/hosts/{id}/hardware relay for the implementing slices; docs/API.md lists no unimplemented interface as implemented.

roadmap.reason: The published roadmap describes shipped behaviour; it changes in the implementing slices. The decision is recorded in docs/plans.

state.reason: No state changes in this record. The planned feature is Core-owned: temperature series in each host's usage history file, hardware read live from the host, nothing kept by the Controller.

verification.method: Documentation link and scope review; documentation and privacy gates run.
